title: Classic SA to AI SA: the transition map
oneliner: Every classic architecture track has an AI counterpart: infrastructure SA to AI infrastructure SA, platform SA to AI platform SA - transition, don't restart.
says: The solutions architect career is transitioning from classic roles to AI-based roles. If you are a classic infrastructure solutions architect provisioning VMs in private, on-premises, or public cloud for platform and application teams, you can transition to AI infrastructure solutions architect. If you are a platform solutions architect in a platform engineering team, you can transition to AI platform solutions architect.
explained: This reel is the bridge between the career content and Season 1's technical episodes - it names the mapping explicitly. The transition keeps your existing judgment (capacity, reliability, cost) and swaps the workload knowledge underneath it: VMs become GPU clusters, app platforms become agent platforms, gateways become model gateways.

The platform-SA line is the forward reference that matters most for this site: the AI platform solutions architect is exactly the role Season 2 teaches. Season 1 transforms the infrastructure architect; Season 2 transforms the platform architect. If you are choosing where to start watching, pick the season matching your current track.
takeaway: Find your current track in the mapping - infra to AI infra, platform to AI platform - and follow the matching season.
